scope: CVG-001 bounded durable WebAuthn credentials and challenge state

criteria.description: Fresh independent scouting identifies process-local WebAuthn credentials and challenges as a P0 shared-runtime security gap; cancellation history remains a separate P1 residual.
criteria.limitations: Scouting selects a bounded repository-local security slice; it does not certify the complete FIDO verifier or production readiness.

criteria.description: The frozen contract requires durable account/user-scoped credentials and purpose-specific challenges with tenant RLS and atomic single-use TTL consumption.
criteria.limitations: The new WebAuthn tables, migration and executable RLS proof are implementation work, not yet complete.

criteria.description: The runtime contract wires durable repositories through bootstrap and fails closed in production-like mode when WebAuthn is enabled without both stores; explicit local/test doubles remain compatible.
criteria.limitations: The current server still constructs process-local state unconditionally; RED/GREEN tests must prove the correction.

criteria.description: The auth-route boundary carries principal account scope into WebAuthn service and challenge operations while preserving only bounded local Map test compatibility.
criteria.limitations: The existing service API is user-only and must be migrated coherently with focused unit/API tests.

criteria.description: TDD RED/GREEN, security review, full regression, coverage, static quality, current-slice control-plane reconciliation and global non-promotion are required before bounded closure.
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes implementation only; it is not a completion or release-readiness verdict.

gaps: Intentional RED and implementation are pending.
Durable schema, RLS, atomic consume and cross-process evidence are pending.
Full FIDO verifier/attestation hardening remains a separate open requirement.
Independent security review, regression, coverage and final control-plane validation are pending.
Global ERP parity, target, production and release evidence remain open.
conditions: Keep credential and challenge state account/user scoped and RLS protected.
Use atomic conditional consume with expiry and consumed-state guards.
Do not silently use in-memory WebAuthn state when enabled in production-like mode.
Preserve explicit local/test compatibility without weakening the production boundary.
Do not expand into FIDO verifier redesign, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release scope.
Keep global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and fresh independent scouting
authority.scope: CVG-001 bounded durable WebAuthn credentials and challenge state
authority.decision: Authorize only repository-local schema/migration/RLS, account-scoped WebAuthn repository/service interfaces, atomic durable challenge state, runtime/bootstrap wiring, production-like fail-closed checks and focused tests. Exclude full FIDO verification, external providers, target, production, deployment and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing WebAuthn verifier semantics, challenge policy beyond purpose/TTL/single-use, external identity, target runtime or any production/release boundary.

next_action: Write and execute intentional RED tests for cross-instance durable state, account isolation, atomic single-use TTL consumption and production-like fail-closed startup before implementing the slice.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to FIDO attestation/signature verification or origin/RP-ID policy
Changes to MFA enrollment/login policy beyond durable state
Changes to external identity, providers, target, production, deployment or release scope
